layer.tcp.sealed.kid: Sealed. Only your phone and the server open this: they check that no pieces are missing.
layer.tcp.sealed.nerd: Not inspected on the way: end-to-end between phone and server (ordering, retransmits, congestion control).
layer.tcp.peek.nerd: The NAT peeks at the port numbers (and may rewrite the source port) but leaves the rest sealed.
